speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe your specific gait and limb ataxia symptoms in detail, and do you have any history of stroke, multiple sclerosis, or head trauma? REQUEST TEST: MRI BRAIN.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Gait Assessment: Ataxic gait noted. Limb Examination: Right Upper Limb Strength 4/5. Coordination Tests: Evidence of ataxia. MRI Brain Findings: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). Comments: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to Natalizumab use for Crohn's disease.
